escrever.ajudaRoda: Only people in your circle of trust. Nobody is notified when added to it.
escrever.rodaVazia: Your circle is empty. Add someone to post only to it.
escrever.rodaNaoAchada: We couldn't find that @ on Alumia.
escrever.rodaAviso: Nobody is told when they join or leave your circle.
escrever.naoListadoAjuda: Anyone with the link can open it. It stays out of timelines, search and notifications.
escrever.someAjuda: When the time is up, the post and its images are really deleted. Other people's replies stay, under “[post deleted]”.
escrever.semAgendar: A scheduled post goes out without these choices. Remove the schedule to post only to the circle, unlisted or with a time to disappear.
escrever.ofensa: Before posting: “{termos}” tends to hurt. Want to revise? Tapping Post again sends it anyway.
escrever.ofensaSoLeitura: Before posting: the text has words that tend to hurt. Tapping Post again sends it, and the post goes to the moderators to read before it appears.
escrever.ofensaLeitura: With these words, the post goes to the moderators to read before it appears.
escrever.ofensaLista: This warning comes from an open list and runs only on this device. You can turn it off in Settings, Life of posts.

cartao.arquivadoFeito: Archived. Only you see it; it is in Settings, Life of posts.
cartao.desarquivadoFeito: Unarchived: it is back for those who could see it.
cartao.leiaTitulo: You haven't opened this post's link yet
cartao.leiaTexto: Want to read it before reposting?

ajustes.apagarAjuda: Posts older than this disappear on their own, with their images. Other people's replies stay, under “[post deleted]”.
ajustes.confirmar: This deletes {n} of your posts older than {prazo} in the next round, within 10 minutes. It can't be undone.
ajustes.confirmarUm: This deletes 1 of your posts older than {prazo} in the next round, within 10 minutes. It can't be undone.
ajustes.confirmarNenhum: None of your posts is older than {prazo} right now. From now on, each one disappears when it passes the limit.
ajustes.ligado: On: posts older than {prazo} disappear on their own.
ajustes.desligado: Off: your posts stay until you delete them.
ajustes.ofensa: Warn me before posting a word that tends to hurt
ajustes.ofensaAjuda: It only warns, never blocks. The list is open and the check runs on this device.
ajustes.leia: Ask before reposting a link I haven't opened
ajustes.arquivadosAjuda: Only you see archived posts. Unarchive them to bring them back to those who could see them.
ajustes.indisponivel: Not available on this server yet.

erros.roda_vazia: Your circle is empty. Add someone before posting only to it.
erros.invalido_some_em: Choose 24 hours or 7 days for the post to disappear.
erros.invalido_semanas: Choose one of the options on the list.
erros.vida_federacao: With the Fediverse on for your profile, unlisted and disappearing posts aren't available yet. Post without that choice or turn the Fediverse off in Settings.

cifra.grupo_suspeito: You can't write in this group right now: someone's key changed.
cifra.sem_chave: Set up this device for the group before posting.
cifra.naoAbre: This can't be opened on this device.
